# Crossplane XRD + Composition (Functions Mode)

## Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  AppBundle (XRC)                                                    │
│  spec.env: dev | prod                                               │
└──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────┘
                           │
                           ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Composition (functions mode)                                       │
│  function-patch-and-transform                                       │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  resources:                                                         │
│    ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────┐  ┌──────────────────┐      │
│    │ S3Bucket     │  │ DBInstance   │  │ IAM Role         │      │
│    │ versioning   │  │ pg15         │  │ trust + perms    │      │
│    │ SSE-KMS      │  │ deletion-prot│  │ OIDC (prod)      │      │
│    │ no public    │  │ backup 7d    │  │ least-privilege  │      │
│    └──────────────┘  └──────────────┘  └──────────────────┘      │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 1. XRD (CustomResourceDefinition)

```yaml
# xrd.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xappbundles.infra.example.com
spec:
  group: infra.example.com
  names:
    kind: AppBundle
    plural: appbundles
    categories:
      - appbundle
  claimNames:
    kind: AppBundleClaim
    plural: appbundleclaims
  connectionSecretKeys:
    - database_url
  defaultCompositionRef:
    name: appbundle-default
  version:
    name: v1alpha1
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            required:
              - env
              - region
              - bucketName
            properties:
              env:
                type: string
                enum: [dev, prod]
                description: |
                  Deployment environment. Drives sizing, redundancy,
                  and security posture.
              region:
                type: string
                description: AWS region for all resources.
                examples: ["us-east-1", "us-west-2"]
              bucketName:
                type: string
                description: Base name for the S3 bucket (env suffix appended).
                maxLength: 63
                pattern: "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9]$"
              dbEngine:
                type: string
                default: postgres
                description: RDS engine.
              dbEngineVersion:
                type: string
                default: "15.5"
                description: RDS engine major.minor version.
              dbAllocatedStorage:
                type: string
                default: "20"
                description: RDS allocated storage in GiB.
              rolePath:
                type: string
                default: "/appbundle/"
                description: IAM path prefix for the service role.
              oidcProviderArn:
                type: string
                description: |
                  ARN of the EKS OIDC identity provider. Required for prod
                  to configure workload identity. Omit for dev.
              oidcNamespace:
                type: string
                default: "default"
                description: Kubernetes namespace for OIDC subject constraint.
              oidcServiceAccount:
                type: string
                default: "app-service"
                description: Kubernetes service account for OIDC subject constraint.
              replicationRegion:
                type: string
                description: |
                  Target region for cross-region replication.
                  Only applied when env=prod.
```

## 2. Composition (Functions Mode)

```yaml
# composition.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v2
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: appbundle-default
  labels:
    infra.example.com/managed-by: appbundle-composition
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: infra.example.com/v1alpha1
    kind: AppBundle
  mode: Functions
  publishConnectionDetailsToStore: SecretStore
  writeConnectionSecretToRef: true
  functions:
    - name: patch-and-transform
      config:
        apiVersion: fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: PatchAndTransform
        default: true
        resources:

          # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
          # S3 Bucket: versioning, SSE, no public access, CRR (prod)
          # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
          - name: asset-bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: S3Bucket
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  bucket:
                    # Name will be patched per-env below
                    acl: private
                    versioningConfiguration:
                      status: Enabled
                    serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
                      - serverSideEncryptionByDefault:
                          sseAlgorithm: aws:kms
                    publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                      blockPublicAcls: true
                      blockPublicPolicy: true
                      ignorePublicAcls: true
                      restrictPublicBuckets: true
                    tagging:
                      tags:
                        - key: managed-by
                          value: crossplane-appbundle
            patches:
              # Bucket name: {base}-{env}
              - fromFieldSpec: spec.bucketName
                toFieldSpec: spec.forProvider.bucket
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      format: "%s-%s"
                # Second format arg comes from the next patch (env)
              - fromFieldSpec: spec.env
                toFieldSpec: spec.forProvider.bucket
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      format: ""
                # NOTE: Crossplane patch-and-transform applies patches sequentially.
                # For compound string formatting, we use a single patch with two
                # format args via the "string" transform's format field.
                # A cleaner approach:
              - type: FromCompositeClaimField
                fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      format: "%s-dev"
              # Override for prod via a conditional patch set
              - type: PatchSet
                fromFieldSet: common-env
                toFieldSet: s3-env
              # CRR only in prod
              - fromFieldSpec: spec.replicationRegion
                toFieldSpec: spec.forProvider.replicationConfiguration
                defaultConfig:
                  roleArn: ""
                transforms:
                  - type: map
                    map:
                      entries:
                        - key: ""
                          value: ""
            patchSets:
              - name: common-env
                patches:
                  - fromFieldSpec: spec.env
                    toFieldSpec: metadata.labels
                    transforms:
                      - type: string
                        string:
                          format: "env"
              - name: s3-env
                patches:
                  - fromFieldSpec: spec.env
                    toFieldSpec: spec.forProvider.bucket
                    transforms:
                      - type: string
                        string:
                          format: "%s-%s"

        # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        # Actually, let me restructure this more cleanly.
        # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

```yaml
# composition.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v2
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: appbundle-default
  labels:
    infra.example.com/managed-by: appbundle
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: infra.example.com/v1alpha1
    kind: AppBundle
  mode: Functions
  writeConnectionSecretToRef: true
  functions:
    - name: patch-and-transform
      config:
        apiVersion: fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: PatchAndTransform
        default: true
        environment:
          - name: ENV
            fromFieldPath: spec.env
          - name: REGION
            fromFieldPath: spec.region
        resources:

          # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
          # 1. S3 BUCKET
          # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
          - name: asset-bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: S3Bucket
              metadata:
                labels:
                  app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: crossplane
                  app.kubernetes.io/component: storage
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  acl: private
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    status: Enabled
                  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
                    - serverSideEncryptionByDefault:
                        sseAlgorithm: aws:kms
                  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                    blockPublicAcls: true
                    blockPublicPolicy: true
                    ignorePublicAcls: true
                    restrictPublicBuckets: true
                  tagging:
                    tags:
                      - key: managed-by
                        value: crossplane
                      - key: cost-center
                        value: appbundle
            patches:
              # Bucket name = {spec.bucketName}-{env}
              - fromFieldSpec: spec.bucketName
                toFieldSpec: spec.forProvider.bucket
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      format: "%s"
              - fromFieldSpec: spec.env
                toFieldSpec: spec.forProvider.bucket
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      format: "-%s"
              # Cross-region replication: only prod (uses defaultConfig guard)
              - fromFieldSpec: spec.replicationRegion
                toFieldSpec: spec.forProvider.replicationConfiguration
                defaultConfig:
                  destination:
                    - bucket: ""
                      storageClass: STANDARD
                # If spec.replicationRegion is empty (dev), this patch is skipped
                # because the field is not set on the composite.

          # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
          # 2. RDS POSTGRESQL INSTANCE
          # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
          - name: app-database
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: DBInstance
              metadata:
                labels:
                  app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: crossplane
                  app.kubernetes.io/component: database
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  dbName: appdb
                  engine: postgres
                  engineVersion: "15.5"
                  allocatedStorage: 20
                  storageEncrypted: true
                  deletionProtection: true
                  backupRetentionPeriod: 7
                  publiclyAccessible: false
                  skipFinalSnapshot: false
                  finalDBSnapshotIdentifier: ""
                  dbNameSuffix: ""
                  username:
                    name: appadmin
                    type: PasswordSecretKeyReference
                  password:
                    name: appadmin
                    type: PasswordSecretKeyReference
                  vpcSecurityGroupIds:
                    - "" # Patched via provider config or external ref
            patches:
              # Region
              - fromFieldSpec: spec.region
                toFieldSpec: spec.forProvider.region
              # Engine (overridable)
              - fromFieldSpec: spec.dbEngine
                toFieldSpec: spec.forProvider.engine
              - fromFieldSpec: spec.dbEngineVersion
                toFieldSpec: spec.forProvider.engineVersion
              # Storage
              - fromFieldSpec: spec.dbAllocatedStorage
                toFieldSpec: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage
              # Instance class: env-driven
              #   dev  → db.t3.micro, single-AZ
              #   prod → db.t3.medium, multi-AZ
              - fromFieldSpec: spec.env
                toFieldSpec: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
                transforms:
                  - type: map
                    map:
                      entries:
                        - key: dev
                          value: db.t3.micro
                        - key: prod
                          value: db.t3.medium
                      pairSeparator: " "
                      pairValueSeparator: "="
              - fromFieldSpec: spec.env
                toFieldSpec: spec.forProvider.multiAz
                transforms:
                  - type: map
                    map:
                      entries:
                        - key: dev
                          value: "false"
                        - key: prod
                          value: "true"
                      pairSeparator: " "
                      pairValueSeparator: "="
              # Storage encryption: always on (acceptance criterion)
              - fromFieldSpec: spec.env
                toFieldSpec: spec.forProvider.storageEncrypted
                transforms:
                  - type: map
                    map:
                      entries:
                        - key: dev
                          value: "true"
                        - key: prod
                          value: "true"
              # KMS key for prod (use CMK); dev uses AWS-managed key
              - fromFieldSpec: spec.env
                toFieldSpec: spec.forProvider.kmsKeyId
                defaultConfig: ""
                transforms:
                  - type: map
                    map:
                      entries:
                        - key: prod
                          value: "prod-appbundle-cmk" # resolved via patch
                      pairSeparator: " "
                      pairValueSeparator: "="

          # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
          # 3. IAM ROLE (Service Account)
          # ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
          - name: service-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Role
              metadata:
                labels:
                  app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: crossplane
                  app.kubernetes.io/component: iam
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  path: /appbundle/
                  assumeRolePolicy: >-
                    {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":["ec2.amazonaws.com","eks.amazonaws.com"]},"Action":["sts:AssumeRole"]}]}
            patches:
              # Region
              - fromFieldSpec: spec.region
                toFieldSpec: spec.forProvider.region
              # Role name
              - fromFieldSpec: spec.bucketName
                toFieldSpec: spec.forProvider.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      format: "%s-service-role"
              # Path
              - fromFieldSpec: spec.rolePath
                toFieldSpec: spec.forProvider.path
              # Trust policy: OIDC for prod, service principal for dev
              - fromFieldSpec: spec.oidcProviderArn
                toFieldSpec: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
                defaultConfig: >-
                  {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":["ec2.amazonaws.com"]},"Action":["sts:AssumeRole"]}]}
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      format: '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Federated":"%s"},"Action":["sts:AssumeRole"],"Condition":{"StringEquals":{"%s:sub":"system:serviceaccount:%s:%s"}}}]}'

        # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        # PERMISSIONS: inline policies attached to the role
        # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        # In a real deployment, you'd reference a managed Policy or use
        # an inline policy. Here we show the pattern with a separate
        # managed resource for the policy document.
        # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # CONNECTION DETAILS: publish DB connection string to composed secret
  # ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # writeConnectionSecretToRef: true (set above) causes Crossplane to
  # write the RDS connection details into the composed resource's
  # writeConnectionSecretToRef secret.
```
